observation.summary: close_session() creates a VoiceOutcome and writes voiceoutcome_ref into every commit-eligible output before constructing the SESSION_CLOSE CortexEventPacket. turn_id and monotonic_ms are validated only by that later event construction. A rejected close with a late-invalid event field can therefore plausibly mutate output state before raising.
observation.candidate_risk: A failed SESSION_CLOSE may leave an otherwise-open cortex with completed output carrying a voiceoutcome_ref for an outcome that was never committed to _closed_outcome and has no SESSION_CLOSE event. export_packet_cortex_checkpoint() serializes output voiceoutcome_ref, so the partial mutation may survive restart as a dangling causal reference.
observation.scope: packet-cortex rejected-operation/session-close atomicity and restart persistence only

precondition: Create an open VoicePacketCortex with one output advanced queued -> started -> completed at heard_fraction=1.0 so it is commit_eligible.
Snapshot output.as_dict()/sha, event count/event_seq, is_open, _closed_outcome, and an exported checkpoint.
high_information_discriminator.action: Call close_session() with otherwise-valid outcome identity/result data but an invalid late-validated event field, preferably turn_id='' (and separately negative monotonic_ms if useful). Catch VoicePacketCortexError. Then compare all pre/post state and export a second checkpoint.
high_information_discriminator.candidate_failure_condition: The close call raises VoicePacketCortexError but any durable/recoverable controller state changes, especially output.voiceoutcome_ref becoming non-null while is_open remains true, _closed_outcome remains null, and no SESSION_CLOSE event exists; or the post-reject checkpoint differs in semantic state from the pre-reject checkpoint.
high_information_discriminator.required_negative_control: A rejected close must be observationally atomic: output packet state, event sequence/list, tool ownership, open/closed fields, outcome fields, and checkpoint payload must remain semantically identical except for no externally persisted diagnostic side effect.
acceptable_repair_shapes: pre-validate all close event fields before VoiceOutcome/output mutation
stage outcome, output replacements, and SESSION_CLOSE event fully, then commit controller state atomically only after every validation succeeds
high_information_discriminator.required_regression: Rejected SESSION_CLOSE cannot mint or persist a dangling voiceoutcome_ref and remains restart/checkpoint-identical at packet-controller scope.

coordination.nonduplicate_reason: That sibling tests successful close with active tool ownership. This candidate tests rollback/atomicity when close itself is rejected after late event-field validation, including dangling VoiceOutcome reference persistence.
coordination.runtime_subject_churn_rule: Do not mutate product source or redispatch VPS from this static candidate. Execute repository discriminator first. Only exact reproduced PRODUCT_NEGATIVE justifies repair/reconciliation of the queued VPS subject.

external_primary_context.livekit_turn_semantics: Current official LiveKit turn documentation still treats interruption as a state transition that truncates conversation history to what was actually heard.
external_primary_context.livekit_tool_semantics: Current official LiveKit tool documentation explicitly distinguishes interrupted speech from tool lifecycle/cancellation; this supports explicit causal ownership but grants no F2 credit.
